title: Female borrowers who specify exact products being purchased for resale fund faster.
Pitches that specify the number of years the borrower has been in business tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.
Male borrowers who list multiple specific crop types may fund faster.
Female borrowers who use the phrase 'essential farm inputs' may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who use the specific phrase 'health and hazard risks' may fund faster.
Pitches from women that explicitly use the phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' are associated with increased funding speed.
Female borrowers who provide specific details about business duration or crop variety may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who link loan purchases to increasing business profit margins may fund faster.
Male borrowers who explicitly promise to repay the loan promptly may fund faster.
Male borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that list specific quantities or types of agricultural inputs predict faster funding regardless of gender.
